queries.item: CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS `?:form_data_values` ( `id` int(11) NOT NULL AUTO_INCREMENT, `form_description_id` int(11) NOT NULL, `field_name` varchar(255) NOT NULL, `field_value` varchar(255) NOT NULL, `form_data_id` int(11) NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY (`id`) ) ENGINE=InnoDB DEFAULT CHARSET=utf8;

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS `?:form_data` ( `id` int(11) NOT NULL AUTO_INCREMENT, `page_id` int(11) NOT NULL, `page_name` varchar(255) NOT NULL, `created_at` timestamp NOT NULL DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, PRIMARY KEY (`id`) ) ENGINE=InnoDB DEFAULT CHARSET=utf8;

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS `?:form_data_images` ( `id` int(11) NOT NULL AUTO_INCREMENT, `name` varchar(255) NOT NULL, `path` varchar(255) NOT NULL, `thumb_path` varchar(255) NOT NULL, `form_data_id` int(11) NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY (`id`) ) ENGINE=InnoDB DEFAULT CHARSET=utf8;
